purpose: Reads the vaults the signed-in person can reach, with their names, parents and landing flag, and decorates the session's vault set with them.
namedChanges: `LWS_VAULTS_URL`, a constant built from the base origin when the module loaded, is the function `lwsVaultsUrl()`, built from the base-origin setting at each call (the setting unit's rule); `listReachableVaults` calls it at both places the source used the constant.

The imports: `NotSignedInError`, `bearerHeaderFor`, `dpopReadAuth`, `invalidateDpop` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-lws-session-bridge`; `serverErrorText` from `lws-records`; `narrowVaultModes` from `vault-modes`; the type `ReachableVault` from `plan-record-hooks`. In the source these are `./token`, `./bearer`, `./dpop`, `./serverError` and `./types`.
`lwsReadAuth` passes the method to `bearerHeaderFor(url, method)`, as `lws-vault-sets` does (the bridge's signature took the URL alone in the app).

The `useMemo` of `useVaults` is the function `decorateSessionVaults(set, richList, enrichFailed)`: its body is the memo's body (`hooks.ts` lines 100-131) with `enrich.isError` as the parameter `enrichFailed`; the hook calls it with `session?.vaults ?? []`, `enrich.data ?? []` and `enrich.isError`, and the same dependency list.
`useVaults` takes `ReachableVaultsSession | undefined` (`{ principal?, vaults? }`) in place of the app's `BaseSession`; the hook reads `principal` and `vaults` only.
Comments: cycle, ticket and person tags are removed; no code changed.
